blocks.text: Getting started with Pages for students on Mac

Pages is built into macOS and offers a clean interface for academic writing. When you launch the app, you see a template chooser. Select a blank template to start from scratch or pick a report template to get a jump start. You can save your own layouts as templates by selecting File > Save as Template. This helps when you have a specific style guide for your department.

items: Command + N to create a new document
Command + S to save your progress
Command + B to bold selected text
Shift + Command + C to open the colors window

blocks.text: Learning these shortcuts saves minutes every hour. If you forget one, use the Menu bar to find the shortcut listed next to the action. You can also customize your own shortcuts in macOS System Settings > Keyboard > Keyboard Shortcuts > App Shortcuts.

Academic papers require proper citations. You can add a footnote by placing your cursor where you want the number to appear. Go to Insert > Footnote. Pages automatically handles the numbering for you. If you need to add a table of contents, go to Insert > Table of Contents. This creates a clickable list based on your heading styles.

Many students struggle when exporting to Microsoft Word. If your formatting looks broken, try to use basic fonts like Arial or Times New Roman. Avoid complex layout elements if you plan to share the file as a .docx. Always check your document in Preview before you submit it to your professor.
How to stay focused while writing

Writing is hard work. Use the full screen mode by clicking the green button in the top left corner of the window. This hides your desktop and other apps. If you get distracted by emails or notifications, use the Do Not Disturb mode in your Control Center. Ask Lazur to set a timer for 25 minutes to use the Pomodoro technique.

faq.question: Is Pages free for students on Mac?
faq.answer: Yes, Pages is free for all Apple device users. Advanced features may require an Apple Creator Studio subscription.

faq.question: How do I save my Pages document as a Word file?
faq.answer: Go to File > Export To > Word. Choose your settings and click Next to save the file.

faq.question: Can I collaborate with other students in Pages?
faq.answer: Yes, you can share documents via iCloud. Click the Collaborate button in the toolbar to invite others to edit.
